title: Coast Guard Assists in Icey Rescue on Lake Michigan
description: ℠2014 - Coast Guard divers assisted the Chicago Fire Department in rescuing a man trapped in ice on Lake Michigan.

transcript.text: The U.S. Coast Guard joined Chicago's Fire Department yesterday to rescue a man from
icy Lake Michigan. Coast Guard officials say the victim was
unresponsive when rescue teams pulled him from the freezing water.
Rescuers say he was suffering from hypothermia and barely clinging to the ice.
The victim was huddled up on the ice. It didn't look like he'd broken all the way
through yet so he was just kind of stuck out there but our divers did end up
breaking through when they were going out so it was very weak ice. The man was
taken to a Chicago hospital where he was listed in critical condition. The
Chicago Great Lakes area has been suffering through a series of winter
storms lately with wind chills plunging below zero. That's your TPC News Update.

pass_reason: TV news package with a reporter voiceover; rescue led by Chicago Fire Department, not federal footage
